review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for Riemannian volume or volume-density constructions (`RiemannianVolume`, `volumeDensity`, case-insensitive) and found none. Under Mathlib/Geometry, only PathELength, Riemannian/Basic and the Euclidean/Volume files mention Measure or MeasurableSpace, and none of them builds a chart-based volume measure. `chartRiemannianVolume` is a new construction: it takes `withDensity` of the model Haar measure, then `comap` along the chart restricted to its source, then `map` by `Subtype.val`. It combines existing Mathlib operations and does not duplicate a Mathlib concept. The private `ChartVolumeDensityData` structure packages a measurable function that agrees with the chart density on the chart target. It is only an implementation device and has no Mathlib counterpart. I did not review the local instances `extChartAtMeasurableSpaceE` and `extChartAtBorelSpaceE` beyond seeing where they are defined. They are in ExtChartAt.lean, outside the target file, so I did not assess them. I found no justified finding for this rubric.
